name: Jonathan van Tulleken
bio: Most recently directed/exec-produced the opening episodes of FX's historical epic Shogun, director/produced The Changeling for Apple as well as the second block of the Ridley Scott helmed Apple series Dope Thief. He has directed the entire Season 2 of the critically acclaimed Top Boy and the BAFTA winning TV series Misfits, episodes of Danny Boyle's drama mini-series Trust and was the pilot director/exec-producer on the HULU original drama series Reprisal. His short films have been nominated for BAFTAs and shown at major international film festivals including Toronto, Palm Springs and Slamdance. His TV mini series Off Season - based on his short film of the same name - is with Complete Fiction. He has a reoccurring collaboration with the critical acclaimed comedian Tim Key and makes many of the films for Tim's live performances including for his Perrier and Chortle award winning shows.…
